# dav1d 1.5.4 (https://code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d, BSD 2-clause, see COPYING), the AV1
# decoder for Switch 2 games' cutscenes. Upstream builds with Meson; this is a CMake build of the
# same library for x86-64 Windows (MSVC) and Linux: 8- and 16-bit, with the x86 assembly when NASM
# is available (on Windows it is downloaded once if it isn't installed), plain C otherwise.

set(DAV1D_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
set(DAV1D_GEN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${DAV1D_GEN})

if (NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "AMD64|x86_64|amd64")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This dav1d build is for x86-64 only")
endif()

# NASM for the assembly: installed, or on Windows a copy downloaded into the build folder.
find_program(DAV1D_NASM nasm)
if (NOT DAV1D_NASM AND WIN32)
    set(nasm_version 2.16.03)
    set(nasm_dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nasm-${nasm_version})
    set(nasm_exe ${nasm_dir}/nasm-${nasm_version}/nasm.exe)
    if (NOT EXISTS ${nasm_exe})
        set(nasm_zip ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/nasm-${nasm_version}-win64.zip)
        file(DOWNLOAD
            https://www.nasm.us/pub/nasm/releasebuilds/${nasm_version}/win64/nasm-${nasm_version}-win64.zip
            ${nasm_zip}
            EXPECTED_HASH SHA256=3ee4782247bcb874378d02f7eab4e294a84d3d15f3f6ee2de2f47a46aa7226e6
            STATUS nasm_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
        list(GET nasm_status 0 nasm_code)
        if (nasm_code EQUAL 0)
            file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT ${nasm_zip} DESTINATION ${nasm_dir})
        else()
            message(WARNING "dav1d: couldn't download NASM (${nasm_status}); building without assembly (slower)")
        endif()
    endif()
    if (EXISTS ${nasm_exe})
        set(DAV1D_NASM ${nasm_exe})
    endif()
endif()
set(DAV1D_HAVE_ASM 0)
if (DAV1D_NASM)
    set(DAV1D_HAVE_ASM 1)
    message(STATUS "dav1d: x86 assembly with ${DAV1D_NASM}")
else()
    message(WARNING "dav1d: NASM not found; building without assembly (slower)")
endif()

# config.h (what Meson's configure step works out, for these two targets)
if (WIN32)
    set(win 1)
    set(posix 0)
else()
    set(win 0)
    set(posix 1)
endif()
file(WRITE ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.h.tmp
"/* Generated by externals/dav1d/CMakeLists.txt */
#pragma once
#define ARCH_AARCH64 0
#define ARCH_ARM 0
#define ARCH_LOONGARCH 0
#define ARCH_LOONGARCH32 0
#define ARCH_LOONGARCH64 0
#define ARCH_PPC64LE 0
#define ARCH_RISCV 0
#define ARCH_RV32 0
#define ARCH_RV64 0
#define ARCH_X86 1
#define ARCH_X86_32 0
#define ARCH_X86_64 1
#define CONFIG_8BPC 1
#define CONFIG_16BPC 1
#define CONFIG_LOG 1
#define ENDIANNESS_BIG 0
#define HAVE_ASM ${DAV1D_HAVE_ASM}
#define HAVE_AS_FUNC 0
#define HAVE_AS_ARCH_DIRECTIVE 0
#define HAVE_C11_GENERIC 0
#define HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME ${posix}
#define HAVE_DLSYM ${posix}
#define HAVE_ELF_AUX_INFO 0
#define HAVE_GETAUXVAL ${posix}
#define HAVE_IO_H ${win}
#define HAVE_MEMALIGN ${posix}
#define HAVE_POSIX_MEMALIGN ${posix}
#define HAVE_ALIGNED_ALLOC 0
#define HAVE_PTHREAD_GETAFFINITY_NP ${posix}
#define HAVE_PTHREAD_NP_H 0
#define HAVE_PTHREAD_SETAFFINITY_NP ${posix}
#define HAVE_PTHREAD_SETNAME_NP ${posix}
#define HAVE_PTHREAD_SET_NAME_NP 0
#define HAVE_SIGACTION ${posix}
#define HAVE_SYS_TYPES_H 1
#define HAVE_UNISTD_H ${posix}
#define TRIM_DSP_FUNCTIONS 1
")
if (WIN32)
    file(APPEND ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.h.tmp
"#define _WIN32_WINNT 0x0601
#define UNICODE 1
#define _UNICODE 1
#define _CRT_DECLARE_NONSTDC_NAMES 1
")
endif()
configure_file(${DAV1D_GEN}/config.h.tmp ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.h COPYONLY)
file(WRITE ${DAV1D_GEN}/vcs_version.h "/* Generated */\n#define DAV1D_VERSION \"1.5.4\"\n")
file(WRITE ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.asm.tmp
"; Generated by externals/dav1d/CMakeLists.txt
%define ARCH_X86_32 0
%define ARCH_X86_64 1
%define PIC 1
%define STACK_ALIGNMENT 16
%define FORCE_VEX_ENCODING 0
%define private_prefix dav1d
")
configure_file(${DAV1D_GEN}/config.asm.tmp ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.asm COPYONLY)

set(dav1d_sources
    cdf.c cpu.c ctx.c data.c decode.c dequant_tables.c getbits.c intra_edge.c itx_1d.c lf_mask.c
    lib.c log.c mem.c msac.c obu.c pal.c picture.c qm.c ref.c refmvs.c scan.c tables.c
    thread_task.c warpmv.c wedge.c x86/cpu.c fefw_state.c)
list(TRANSFORM dav1d_sources PREPEND ${DAV1D_SRC}/)
if (WIN32)
    list(APPEND dav1d_sources ${DAV1D_SRC}/win32/thread.c)
endif()
set(dav1d_tmpl_sources
    cdef_apply_tmpl.c cdef_tmpl.c fg_apply_tmpl.c filmgrain_tmpl.c ipred_prepare_tmpl.c
    ipred_tmpl.c itx_tmpl.c lf_apply_tmpl.c loopfilter_tmpl.c looprestoration_tmpl.c
    lr_apply_tmpl.c mc_tmpl.c recon_tmpl.c)
list(TRANSFORM dav1d_tmpl_sources PREPEND ${DAV1D_SRC}/)

set(dav1d_includes ${DAV1D_GEN} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
                   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/dav1d)
if (MSVC)
    # MSVC has no C11 <stdatomic.h> without /experimental:c11atomics: dav1d's own shim.
    list(APPEND dav1d_includes ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/compat/msvc)
    # /Z7: symbols in eden.pdb, so a hang dump shows where in dav1d a thread waits (issue #22).
    set(dav1d_options /W0 /wd4028 /wd4090 /wd4996 /wd5287 /fp:fast /Z7)
else()
    set(dav1d_options -w -fvisibility=hidden -fomit-frame-pointer -ffast-math -std=gnu99)
    set(dav1d_definitions _GNU_SOURCE)
endif()

# The templated DSP code, once per bit depth.
set(dav1d_bitdepth_objects)
foreach(bitdepth 8 16)
    add_library(dav1d_bitdepth_${bitdepth} OBJECT ${dav1d_tmpl_sources})
    target_include_directories(dav1d_bitdepth_${bitdepth} PRIVATE ${dav1d_includes})
    target_compile_definitions(dav1d_bitdepth_${bitdepth} PRIVATE BITDEPTH=${bitdepth} ${dav1d_definitions})
    target_compile_options(dav1d_bitdepth_${bitdepth} PRIVATE ${dav1d_options})
    list(APPEND dav1d_bitdepth_objects $<TARGET_OBJECTS:dav1d_bitdepth_${bitdepth}>)
endforeach()

# x86 assembly, one NASM call per file.
set(dav1d_asm_objects)
if (DAV1D_HAVE_ASM)
    set(dav1d_asm
        cpuid msac pal refmvs itx_avx512 cdef_avx2 itx_avx2 cdef_sse itx_sse
        cdef_avx512 filmgrain_avx512 ipred_avx512 loopfilter_avx512 looprestoration_avx512 mc_avx512
        filmgrain_avx2 ipred_avx2 loopfilter_avx2 looprestoration_avx2 mc_avx2
        filmgrain_sse ipred_sse loopfilter_sse looprestoration_sse mc_sse
        cdef16_avx512 filmgrain16_avx512 ipred16_avx512 itx16_avx512 loopfilter16_avx512
        looprestoration16_avx512 mc16_avx512 cdef16_avx2 filmgrain16_avx2 ipred16_avx2 itx16_avx2
        loopfilter16_avx2 looprestoration16_avx2 mc16_avx2 cdef16_sse filmgrain16_sse ipred16_sse
        itx16_sse loopfilter16_sse looprestoration16_sse mc16_sse)
    if (WIN32)
        set(nasm_format win64)
        set(obj_ext obj)
    else()
        set(nasm_format elf64)
        set(obj_ext o)
    endif()
    foreach(name ${dav1d_asm})
        set(input ${DAV1D_SRC}/x86/${name}.asm)
        set(output ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/asm/${name}.${obj_ext})
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${output}
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/asm
            COMMAND ${DAV1D_NASM} -f ${nasm_format} -I ${DAV1D_SRC}/ -I ${DAV1D_GEN}/
                    -MQ ${output} -MF ${output}.d ${input} -o ${output}
            DEPENDS ${input} ${DAV1D_GEN}/config.asm
            DEPFILE ${output}.d
            COMMENT "dav1d: assembling ${name}.asm"
            VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND dav1d_asm_objects ${output})
    endforeach()
endif()

add_library(dav1d STATIC ${dav1d_sources} ${dav1d_bitdepth_objects} ${dav1d_asm_objects})
set_source_files_properties(${dav1d_asm_objects} PROPERTIES EXTERNAL_OBJECT TRUE GENERATED TRUE)
target_include_directories(dav1d PRIVATE ${dav1d_includes})
target_include_directories(dav1d SYSTEM INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_definitions(dav1d PRIVATE ${dav1d_definitions})
target_compile_options(dav1d PRIVATE ${dav1d_options})
if (NOT WIN32)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(dav1d PRIVATE Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()
add_library(dav1d::dav1d ALIAS dav1d)
